name: Auli-D Food Plaza
why_it_matters: Ranked the top-reviewed standalone restaurant in Joshimath on TripAdvisor — a multi-cuisine sit-down attached to Hotel Auli D on NH-7 near Punjab National Bank. The kitchen runs the full Joshimath default: butter chicken, veg thali, momos, Indo-Chinese.
insider_tip: Open 9 AM-11 PM daily. Parking on the highway shoulder is tight; if you're driving in from Govindghat, ask the staff to slot your car behind the building.
signature_address: National Highway 58, Near Punjab National Bank, Main Bazaar, Joshimath 246443

name: Hotel Auli D Restaurant
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant of Hotel Auli D — Joshimath's #2-ranked specialty lodge — runs strictly pure-veg with a substantial Jain menu, which is why Char Dham yatris in pilgrim mode book here. Distinct kitchen from the next-door Auli-D Food Plaza; the hotel side is meatless.
insider_tip: If you're not staying here, dinner is still walk-in friendly. Ask for the Jain thali if you want onion-garlic-free; otherwise the regular veg thali is the better-rounded plate.
signature_address: Badrinath Road, Near Petrol Pump, Main Bazaar, Joshimath 246443

name: Panchvati Inn Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the few Joshimath restaurants that takes Garhwali pahadi food seriously — kafuli (green-leaf curry), phaanu, mandua (finger millet) roti — alongside the multi-cuisine default. Attached to Panchvati Inn near Singhdhar bus stand, the only hotel in town with a working elevator.
insider_tip: Open 8 AM-11 PM. Order the Garhwali plate in advance — they prep pahadi dishes to order, not from a hot counter, so allow 30-40 minutes.
signature_address: Near Post Office, Singhdhar Bus Stand, Joshimath 246443

name: GMVN Tourist Rest House Restaurant
why_it_matters: Garhwal Mandal Vikas Nigam runs the state's tourist-rest-house network; the Joshimath restaurant at the Narsingh Tourist Complex is the safe canteen-style fall-back for solo travellers and yatris — clean, vegetarian, no-frills, prices well below the private hotels.
insider_tip: Order the morning poori and special poha — both made fresh per order, not from a buffet. The kitchen takes 20-30 minutes for à la carte; thali is faster.
signature_address: GMVN Narsingh Tourist Complex, Main Bazar, Joshimath 246443

name: Hotel Snow Crest Restaurant
why_it_matters: Multi-cuisine in-house restaurant of Hotel Snow Crest, sat near the Auli ropeway base on NH-7 — the kitchen leans Char Dham yatri (Gujarati, Rajasthani, South Indian thalis) because that's the bus group it serves. Reviewers single out the khichdi.
insider_tip: Walk-ins are accepted but priority is given to in-house yatra groups during dinner (7-9 PM). If you're independent, eat at 6:30 PM or after 9.
signature_address: Hotel Snow Crest, NH-7 / Ropeway Road, Joshimath 246443

name: Hotel Dronagiri (Ahaar Restaurant)
why_it_matters: Dronagiri's in-house multi-cuisine restaurant 'Ahaar' on Main Badrinath Road — set up to feed company-employee groups on contractual stays, which is why the menu defaults to homely north-Indian (rajma chawal, paratha-tea, dal-rice) rather than tourist showpieces.
insider_tip: Food choice is limited but consistently fresh. They cook to order — give 30 minutes from arrival; faster if you call ahead.

name: J.M.S Restaurant
why_it_matters: Sit-down Indian-Chinese on Narsingh Mandir Marg near the PWD office, with a Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice tag and Himalayan-range views from the upper floor. One of the few Joshimath restaurants not tied to a hotel booking.
insider_tip: Open 9:30 AM-10 PM. Sit upstairs near the window — the south-side view of Hathi Parvat is the reason to come, not the menu.
signature_address: Narsingh Mandir Marg, Near PWD, Main Bazaar, Joshimath 246443

name: Mohit Restaurant
why_it_matters: Pure-veg, no-frills sit-down on Upper Bazaar that locals point Char Dham yatris towards when the GMVN canteen is full. Stuffed parathas (aloo, paneer, gobi) and the chilli potato are the order most reviewers reach for.
insider_tip: Cash-preferred; UPI is accepted but the owner sometimes asks for paper if the network is patchy (which it is on Auli ropeway days). Carry ₹500 small.
